profile:
COMPANY NAME: Tandy Leather, Inc.
INDUSTRY: Leathercraft Supplies & Education
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: Sells leather materials, tools, and hardware for leatherworking, and offers in-person and online leathercraft classes.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Hobbyists, professional leatherworkers, and DIY enthusiasts.
PRICING MODEL: Pay-per-item / Retail
KEY FEATURES:
- Wide selection of leather materials and utility leather
- Leathercraft classes and educational resources
- Global shipping and multi-language support
- Customer rewards program
- Physical store locator for in-person services
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: Combines retail supply with hands-on education and community support for leather artisans.
TONE & POSITIONING: Professional, educational, and accessible to both beginners and experts.
